scope: Saved native semantic, connectivity, model and firmware binding; separate from native ERC/DRC or physical qualification

D91_review.logical_geometry_review: Pin1 root -500000,0 extends left to -1500000,0; cathode stem -500000 to -300000 meets zener cathode bar at x=-300000. Anode triangle base x=400000 meets stem to pin2 root 500000,0 extending right to1500000,0. No reversed polarity or body/pin gap. All original pin geometry and electrical types retained.

limits: Canonical comparisons protect exact saved geometry; they do not substitute Altium native project validation or PCB DRC.
Source/library pin editing-access bit 0x20 remains a documented difference; functional pin geometry and electrical properties are equal.
PcbLib comparison covers footprint presence and pad names, sides and copper sizes. Intentional board-instance silk and antenna-feed overrides remain separately documented.
Firmware source hashes bind the previously executed MSVC AddressSanitizer host tests. No new hardware test or ARM execution is asserted.
Thermal, power-transient, effective-capacitance/stability, NFC tuning/read and system ESD qualification remain NOT TESTED.
